queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Keywords as in Google News search. Operators work: "exact phrase", OR, -exclude, site:reuters.com, intitle:word.

topics.title: Topics (headlines)
topics.description: Optional topic headlines: TOP, WORLD, NATION, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, ENTERTAINMENT, SCIENCE, SPORTS, HEALTH. Up to 100 articles each.

editions.title: Editions (country:language)
editions.description: Google News editions as COUNTRY:language, e.g. US:en, GB:en, UA:uk, UA:ru, DE:de, FR:fr, ES:es, IT:it, PL:pl, BR:pt-419, IN:en, JP:ja. Several editions run the same queries in each.

timeframe.title: Time period
timeframe.description: Only articles from the last hour, day, 7 days, 30 days or year. Ignored when dates are set.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: First day (inclusive), e.g. 2026-11-01 or a relative "7 days".

maxArticlesPerQuery.title: Max articles per query
maxArticlesPerQuery.description: Google News shows up to 100 articles per search. Above 100, the date range (or time period, 30 days by default) is read day by day to collect more.

includeRelatedCoverage.title: Related coverage
includeRelatedCoverage.description: Add other outlets covering the same story (title, source, link) when Google News groups them: usually in topic headlines, rarely in search results.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed normally. Turn on only if Google starts limiting requests for very large runs.
